modules.title: Profile images that read as trust
modules.purpose: A sharp banner and headshot, graded to match: the first trust signal.

modules.title: Answer the six proof questions
modules.purpose: Six short answers that decide what the profile may claim and what to build next.

modules.title: Headline, About and top 3 roles, from proven answers only
modules.purpose: Rewrite the profile in recruiter search words, claiming only what the proof answers support.

modules.title: Design board: 35+ images of your taste
modules.purpose: Collect 35+ images until you can name the style that ties your work together.

modules.title: Portfolio site live
modules.purpose: A personal site in your own design system, led by one project page.

modules.title: Three pinned repos, one with a 60–90s walkthrough
modules.purpose: Pinned repos with clear READMEs and a short walkthrough video.

modules.title: List 25–30 people in the seat you want
modules.purpose: A named list of the people already doing, or hiring for, the job you want.

modules.title: Posting kit: your voice doc and your first post
modules.purpose: Your voice doc built from your own writing, then a first post drafted in that voice for you to make yours and post.

modules.title: Network sprint: show up where they post
modules.purpose: Daily habits: connect, comment, save the best posts, post twice a week.

modules.title: Post the build: three posts from real work
modules.purpose: Three posts from your build, drafted for you from your project: a decision, a diagram, the system in motion.

modules.title: Pick your practice project from five made for you
modules.purpose: Five practice projects aimed at the job you want, written from your record; you pick one and it goes on your map.

modules.title: Pick one small, highly visual feature
modules.purpose: Choose one feature you can build in weeks and show clearly, with its done-when.

modules.title: Your practice project: build it, ship it, post it
modules.purpose: The project you picked from your list, scoped to ship in days, on your map with its brief.

modules.title: Build it the standard linear way
modules.purpose: Research, plan, build, test, ship: one system built with a coding agent, each phase proven before the next.

modules.title: Build it: real tools, approval, traces, evals
modules.purpose: Ship a workflow agent with real tools, human approval, traces, evals and a deploy.

modules.title: One real user
modules.purpose: Measure one number, watch a real person use it, fix what breaks, measure again.

modules.title: Case study: before → after
modules.purpose: One page from a real user: by hand, what you built, what changed.

modules.title: Set the title cluster and target companies
modules.purpose: The handful of titles that name the same job, and 15 companies hiring for them.

modules.title: Warm path: 10 hiring managers, 10 people in the seat
modules.purpose: Twenty warm contacts, five notes a week that lead with the case study.

modules.title: Target campaigns: five companies, every channel, on a cadence
modules.purpose: Pick the five companies where hiring, size and fit overlap, then work each one by email with a Loom, LinkedIn and a phone call, with follow-ups on day 3, 7 and 14.

modules.title: Prep notes for your top 5 companies
modules.purpose: One page per top company: what they sell, who deploys it, where your proof fits.

modules.title: Offer reported
modules.purpose: The end of the path: the offer, reported.

modules.title: Story bank from the case study
modules.purpose: Five two-minute stories, each with a number, built from real work.

modules.title: Mock interview (recorded)
modules.purpose: A recorded mock with written feedback; your coach's notes say which kind.

modules.title: Run and trace a codebase you did not write
modules.purpose: A messy practice system running on your machine, and a ticket traced through it end to end.

modules.title: Ship a reviewed change to code you inherited
modules.purpose: A pull request that fixes a real defect, with the test that catches it and the review thread.

modules.title: Application engine running in week 1
modules.purpose: A daily cadence of tailored applications, tracked, so the search moves while the proof is built.

modules.title: Side quest: a reading
modules.purpose: An optional reading; the step names which one and what to do with it.

modules.title: Meet engineers in person: one event near you
modules.purpose: Go to a local meetup or event in the space you want to work in, meet people, and turn each conversation into a connection you follow up on.

modules.title: Verification proof: audit an AI-built app and fix what it got wrong
modules.purpose: With the owner's permission, audit a real AI-built app for the mistakes AI makes and fix the critical ones.

modules.title: Build your resume, one question at a time
modules.purpose: Turn what you've done into a resume where every line is true, specific and yours, then download it.
